name: Acp
description: Agent 客户端协议服务 (ACP)：支持从外部编辑器 (如 Zed) 或 Web UI 远程驱动与调度 DeepSeek Agent。
descriptionEn: Agent Client Protocol (ACP) server plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) - drive dsh agents from Zed, any ACP v1 client, or the built-in web UI over stdio / HTTP+SSE, with sessions, jobs, goals, skills and the agent tree on the wire
author: MingLin
